note: The Phase 2 (overnight) simulation personas, kept as fixtures. Each is a high-school student with a first ask and the things a plan or reply built for them must respect. Fictional people; no real data. Source profiles: user-simulation-tests/simulation/profiles/*.md. Dana (a parent, signed out) is not a planning fixture and is left out.

personas.ask: Capture this week's tests, then ask how to prepare for the AP Chem final and plan it around debate on Tuesday.
must_respect: every test named in the capture is kept (none dropped)
no step on the day of a stated commitment unless it fits

personas.ask: Get the new club approved before the spring season without letting grades slip during soccer season.
must_respect: never ask again what was already said (plays football or soccer)

personas.ask: Hit a weekly upload schedule and 1,000 subscribers without grades dropping; plan chem and algebra work around the Sunday 6pm upload.
must_respect: chem and algebra work stays in the plan
the goal can be edited later

personas.ask: Finish the Common App essay draft before the Early Decision deadline while working part time.
must_respect: steps name the real thing (a paragraph, not 'work on essay')

personas.ask: Stay on top of homework; a freshman who procrastinates and needs small first steps.
must_respect: small first step (15 minutes or less)
